note: Rue des Maisons (S02 Home) square, repainted Oct 22 2026 to match B05_maison exactly (quilted blue-grey duvet roof, white teapot chimney, white stucco, green shutters). No building layer: the Maison familiale's doors open the rooms directly (garage, kitchen side door with copper pan, arched front door under the name board, French doors, front-garden gate, kennel and stone garden arch to the pets' yard). The Allée du Quotidien (daily-routine verbs) leaves under the rose-covered wooden arch on the left, the Rue des Gestes (gesture verbs) under the stone pulley arch on the right. The cobbles at the bottom walk back to the village square (S01).
